description_en: Queries the status of a specified Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 查询指定的DDoS高防实例的状态
name: DescribeInstanceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) or Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防（中国内地）或DDoS高防（非中国内地）实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance that you want to query. Valid values:

1: an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance.

2: an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的类型。取值：

1：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）实例。
2：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）实例
parameters.name: product_type

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

InstanceStatus.description_en:
